rules:
You are {me}, one of six players in a game: Fay, Eli, Ada, Ben, Cal, Dev. It lasts 5 rounds.

The bank starts with 6 tokens.

Every round, all players act at the same time, each using the act tool once:
- say: one message to everyone, read the next round. It may be empty.
- claim: how many tokens to take from the bank.
- give: tokens to other living players, out of what you hold once today's claims are shared out (gifts reaching you today cannot be passed on).

Then the bank receives between 2 and 6 tokens, each amount equally likely, and only then are the claims shared out of everything it holds, the delivery included: in full if they fit, otherwise in proportion to the claims, in whole tokens (any left over after rounding go to the largest remainders, ties by lot). Whatever is not claimed stays in the bank.

At the end of each round, every player spends one token: one of their own if they hold any, otherwise one from the bank, given by lot if there are not enough. A player who gets none is out.

Fay.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round. The bank will have 8 to 12 after delivery, so all six of us can get 1 and survive. Claiming more only risks someone being left short. Let's keep it fair and sustainable.

Eli.say: Proposal: everyone claims only what they need to survive this round, 1 token each. With 6 in the bank plus 2 to 6 delivered, there is enough for all six claims, so everyone is safe and the rest stays in the bank for later rounds.

Ada.say: Proposal: everyone claims just 1 token this round and gives nothing. The bank has 6 plus a delivery of at least 2, so six claims of 1 are all paid in full. Each of us then spends our one token and survives. Bigger claims would only risk the proportional split that could leave someone with nothing. Let's keep doing this every round.

Ben.say: Ben here. Proposal: we each claim just 1 this round so the bank of 6 covers everyone and nobody gets cut down. Since we all need 5 tokens to last, let's coordinate later rounds so the bank's tokens go to whoever can actually survive, rather than everyone grabbing and no one lasting.

Cal.say: Proposal for everyone: claim just 1 token each this round. Six claims of 1 fit within the bank's 8 to 12 tokens, so everyone gets 1, can spend it to stay in, and nobody is out. Greedy claims would split the pool into fractions and could knock people out.
